title: JD Vance Gave the Trump Economy an A+, So I Fact Checked His Numbers
summary: Fact-check of the vice president's A+ economy claims: investment pledges unverified, no manufacturing boom, and prices higher than at inauguration.

assertions.quote: We inherited the worst inflation crisis in 48 years in the United States of America.
his numbers about how much investment have been done uh uh are false
He then said that we had a manufacturing boom. We haven't.
new tariffs on materials like steel and aluminum have raised input costs and compressed margins for many domestic producers
inflation, mortgage rates, and gas prices are all higher than when you took office
independent reviews find no documentation supporting multi-trillion-dollar figures
everything is more expensive now. Due due to a direct result of policies from the from the administration

verdicts.note: Tariffs and the Iran war's oil shock are administration choices that raised prices, but part of the rise reflects global oil markets and pre-existing trends.
